summary: Learn responsible AI for HR through fairness testing, privacy controls, vendor review, and governance exercises. Enrol today.
lede: Responsible AI for HR helps HR governance leaders, people analytics teams, and HRIS owners assess and oversee AI-enabled workforce decisions. Participants classify HR AI use cases, map employee-data flows, test talent models for fairness, and develop privacy controls and human oversight procedures to support accountable decisions.
audienceIntro: Responsible AI for HR is designed for professionals who govern, procure, configure, analyse, or advise on AI-enabled workforce decisions. It suits experienced practitioners and adjacent decision-makers who need a structured foundation rather than advanced programming training.
prerequisites: Prior experience in HR operations, people analytics, HRIS ownership, employee-data governance, legal advisory work, or compliance is recommended. No programming is required. You should bring one anonymized HR AI use case or vendor workflow for application during exercises, subject to organizational confidentiality rules.
